e8b_medium_ledger.scope: every MEDIUM and LOW finding from the three review lenses of the previous round, plus findings raised in this session, each classified and dispositioned. No finding is silently dismissed.

classification_rules.execution-critical: must be fixed before any core training
classification_rules.scientific-validity: must be fixed, or proven not to affect the frozen primary protocol
classification_rules.provenance/reproducibility: must be fixed where it affects reconstruction
classification_rules.reporting/documentation: may remain only if scheduled for dissertation cleanup and cannot mislead execution

entries.issue: Frozen LM training-path numerics change bf16->fp32 under autocast; A1_precision said training 'unchanged' and nothing pinned the LM training dtype
entries.evidence: build_core_recipe now carries training_precision AND frozen_lm_instance_dtype explicitly, both inside recipe_sha256. Under bf16 autocast every per-op operand is the exactly-representable pinned bf16 value, so the training math equals the pinned-bf16 construction; this is stated in the recipe rather than assumed.

entries.issue: build_core_recipe still emitted max_epochs 100 and patience 10 for B2/B3, contradicting the fixed-22 decision, and the budget sat outside the hash
entries.evidence: B2/B3 recipes now carry max_epochs 22, early_stopping False, patience 'disabled', canonical_checkpoint_rule epoch_22 and primary_checkpoint_selection fixed_endpoint, all INSIDE recipe_sha256. Protocol family bumped to e8b-fp32-fixed22-core-2026-08-07 so any earlier recipe/checkpoint fails resume.

entries.issue: assert_lm_buffer_parity had no runnable call site; the OI5 pair check never executed
entries.evidence: Called in preflight on the two live inventories AND in _train_core_locked for every B2/B3 cell, comparing this arm against its counterpart, after construction and before the first optimizer step.

entries.issue: Fixing the epoch count equalises draws but not max-over-epochs selection bias (~0.008-0.010/cell), which does not cancel in B3-B2; no selection-free estimator planned
entries.evidence: Superseded by the user's fixed-endpoint decision: the primary checkpoint is epoch 22, not the max over epochs, so there is no max-over-epochs selection bias in the primary contrast at all. Best-of-22 survives only as a labelled secondary diagnostic that cannot determine the primary comparison, the freeze or the clean-test checkpoint. Per-row canonical predictions are dumped for paired tests.

entries.issue: B1 keeps patience-10/max-100 while B2/B3 are fixed, so B1-involving contrasts retain the run-length confound
entries.evidence: The user's decision F is explicit that B1 retains its frozen section 7.3 recipe and must not be forced onto the 22-epoch rule. B1 is an interface-width control, not part of the primary B3-B2 contrast, which is unaffected. The asymmetry is recorded in the recipe (B1 canonical_checkpoint_rule = best dev accuracy, section 7.3 inherited) and in CLAUDE.md.
entries.closed_by: training.py build_core_recipe B1 branch; CLAUDE.md gate item 5

entries.issue: lm.config.dtype and generation_config differed between the paired arms and were covered by no hash or pair check
entries.evidence: load_frozen_causal_lm now normalises config.dtype for both arms and loads generation_config from the pinned snapshot for both, so no frozen state other than the parameter values differs across the pair. Both are recorded in provenance.

entries.issue: Resource projection and abandonment evidence had no committed generator; npz untracked; B1 hours not reproducible
entries.evidence: core_resource_projection.py and determinism_call_scan.py are committed generators that regenerate their records; the npz is force-added; B1 hours now derive from the MEASURED 86.36 s/epoch 250k rate rather than a step-scaled guess.

entries.issue: Supersession map incomplete: u4_decision.json still PROMOTE, protocol_clarification still authorised grid 2-8, preregistration U4_OPEN, g14_v2_preregistration contradicted the amendment
entries.evidence: superseded_evidence_20260807.json now carries 14 records including all four, each with why-wrong and replacement. Source files preserved verbatim; live constants carry the withdrawal.

entries.issue: dev_r1_predictions (the BF16 selection function) survived and was still wired into the only training loop and both G14 invocations
entries.evidence: dev_r1_predictions is DELETED. The only evaluation entry points are canonical_dev_predictions (LM arms) and b1_canonical_predictions (B1), both fp32 with fail-closed dtype gates. The search trainer that called it is deleted too.

entries.issue: The timing anchoring every projection was measured without GPU-exclusivity and without a run lock
entries.evidence: determinism_probe now asserts GPU exclusivity before timing anything and asserts its own non-scientific authorisation constant. Probe runs 3/4 (the timing source) were measured on an idle exclusive GPU.

entries.issue: G14-FP32 validated at chunk size 64, not the canonical 128
entries.evidence: The gate now chunks at 128, the canonical evaluation batch size named in the frozen specification.

entries.issue: The abandoned search was refused only at the CLI; train_search_point had no authorisation guard, and the probe bypassed authorisation
entries.evidence: train_search_point, train_pilot and _train_locked are DELETED, so no search execution path exists at any entry. The probe asserts NONSCIENTIFIC_PROBE_AUTHORIZED. Every scientific entry refuses on TRAINING_AUTHORIZED.

entries.issue: Storage gate declared passed against free space, reversing the E8A record that declared the allocation UNRESOLVED
entries.evidence: The storage gate now records status UNRESOLVED with the free-space check reported separately as context, matching the E8A precedent.

entries.issue: remaining_core_hours gated against the 180 h ceiling but covered only E8B
entries.evidence: Renamed e8b_remaining_vs_180h_core with an explicit scope_note stating it covers E8B cells and E8B evaluation only, and naming the remaining E8A component.

entries.issue: The 22-epoch budget was selected from observed search results, contradicting A3's claim that no selection was performed on any observed result
entries.evidence: The recipe now separates the two: fixed_hyperparameters_justification (lr/warmup/dropout retained PRE-RESULT) and epoch_budget_justification (a DATED POST-DIAGNOSTIC amendment fixed after seeing best epochs 20/11/6). The distinction is inside the hashed recipe.

entries.issue: 'Strict determinism costs 45 per cent' was confounded with the FP32 promotion and the SDPA backend change
entries.evidence: Relabelled amended_design_cost_note: the 78.0 vs 53.88 s/epoch difference is the TOTAL cost of the amended design relative to the superseded one, bundling three simultaneous changes, and is not attributed to any single one.

entries.issue: The identity headroom carried no re-run budget
entries.evidence: retry_allowance now records NONE explicitly: the plan tolerates zero B3 retries and any retry or extra B3-loading evaluation triggers a stop-and-ask before execution.

entries.issue: assert_canonical_scores was vacuous; the frozen-LM dtype check sampled a single parameter
entries.evidence: assert_canonical_scores now also enforces finiteness (a NaN would otherwise pass every threshold and sail through argmax). canonical_prefix checks the FULL dtype set of both the trainable model and the frozen LM, not one sampled parameter.

entries.issue: G14 halt details omitted questionId/imageId; the record omitted the minimum margin
entries.evidence: g14_fp32_gate takes dev_frame and records questionId and imageId in every halt detail; dev_margin_quantiles now includes min.

entries.issue: canonical_prefix's autocast guard did not see CPU autocast
entries.evidence: torch.is_autocast_enabled('cpu') added to the guard.

entries.issue: g14_fp32_gate checked only the length of the supplied margins
entries.evidence: Length is checked AND all margins must be finite (a non-finite margin now halts, so a numerical failure cannot escape stratum L). Binding margins to a model-state digest is not implemented; the residual risk is confined to a caller passing another checkpoint's margins, and the only caller passes the margins returned by the immediately preceding canonical pass on the same model.

entries.issue: determinism_probe.compare() truncated silently on unequal epoch counts and did not compare the determinism/precision blocks
entries.evidence: compare() now hard-exits on any epoch-count mismatch and compares the determinism and fp32_precision blocks in run_level_checks.

entries.issue: save_resume_checkpoint stamped the module protocol_family unconditionally
entries.evidence: protocol_family is now a required keyword argument taken from the recipe, so a run can only stamp its own family.

entries.issue: Non-buffer frozen state outside the OI5 inventory differed between arms
entries.evidence: Same fix as A-M6: config.dtype normalised and generation_config pinned for both arms.

entries.issue: CLAUDE.md materially stale ('Phase 1 has not begun')
entries.evidence: Replaced with a dated, binding seven-point E8B gate covering the abandoned search, the fixed recipe, withdrawn U4, FP32 canonical evaluation, the epoch-22 endpoint rule, the determinism discipline and the refusal of scientific execution.

entries.issue: The determinism probe's GPU time was not charged anywhere
entries.evidence: spent_compute() itemises probes 1-4 from their own recorded walls and charges them to the pretrained identity.

entries.issue: B1's per-cell hours used a step-scaled 250k rate rather than the measured one; B1 final evaluation was charged at the LM R1 pass rate
entries.evidence: B1 now uses the MEASURED 86.36 s/epoch 250k rate from section 13.2; the B1 final-evaluation line is explicitly labelled an upper bound and never touches an identity ceiling because B1 loads no LM.

entries.issue: The selection-sensitivity study (22 checkpoints x R2/R3 = 44 passes) was still costed although the fixed-endpoint rule voids its object
entries.evidence: Recorded VOID under the fixed-22 epoch-22-canonical rule and removed from the projection; reinstating any analogue requires a fresh user decision and a fresh projection.
